decisions.reason: The rye country bread is a core everyday item made with established recipes and production at low marginal cost, so it meets aspirations and gives no trigger for problemistic search.
The seeded rye mixed bread fits the established bread range and uses existing resources, and with no sign of a shortfall the firm has no reason to drop it.
The dark malt rye bread is a niche variant exposed to range pruning, as the withdrawal of the ancient grain bread shows, but it runs on the existing line and slack lets the firm carry it.
With the premium raisin stollen withdrawn, the marzipan stollen carries the seasonal stollen offer in the gift assortment and is cheap to keep, so search pressure points elsewhere.
